scope: Current composed surfaces and continuous millwork/seasonal sky, retaining unchanged native prop reviews.

images.observation: Wood floor, plaster, furniture and lamp are present without missing-material appearance; warm lighting limits subtle surface judgment.
Table, chairs and workbench retain wood grain direction; plaster and hardware render in the composed apartment.
Furniture, floor and wall stock render consistently in the occupied room.
Jacket, cast doors, copper and mineral pipe fittings render with distinct finishes.
Three glazed sectional sashes are visible; rail and stile grain follows the members.
Both circular live displays remain active within textured cabinet bodies.
Opened tray exposes individual crumbs with the new stock finish; appliance and kettle remain distinct.
Station label, case, latch and indicator remain legible after finish binding.
Open cabinet exposes ceramic holders and separate metal fittings.
Wood frame, brass door stock, headers and occupant cards remain distinct.
Valve assembly and wood terminal cabinet remain present with retained glowing display.
Native Blender batch review: repaired authored UVs retain geometry and material orientation across the fittings.
Native sash stock has longitudinal grain on rails and stiles, with separate clear glazing.
Native physical paper plane has a visible paper finish and authored UVs; this view does not verify gameplay label placement.
Native cast and sheet-metal geometry retains its silhouette with continuous mapped stock.
Beaded baseboard seats on the wall and floor; separate bead and metre-scaled painted stock render clearly.
Molded wood cap has horizontal grain distinct from vertical panel backing, with separate rails, stiles and upper eye rail.
Native Blender profile review shows distinct cap, rails, stiles and backing with longitudinal grain and rounded section.
Seasonal optical review: cloud density, sky palette and noise-edged silhouettes render without shader errors; representative artistic appearance, not universal photorealism or measured FPS.
